chunks: ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb narrated from Abū Ḥamzah, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام, that he used to say:

"Beasts have not been left ignorant of four things: their knowledge of their Lord, Blessed and Exalted; their knowledge of death; their knowledge of the female from the male; and their knowledge of fertile pasture."
ai.seo_question: What does Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام say animals inherently know?
ai.summary: This hadith states that animals possess an innate recognition of certain fundamental realities. Among these are recognition of their Lord, awareness of death, distinction between male and female, and awareness of fertile grazing land.
